en: This is the reverse side of a vintage postcard, containing address and postal markings. The postcard features printed text in multiple languages (French, German, Italian) and is preprinted with 'SCHWEIZ. SUISSE. SVIZZERA.' indicating Switzerland. There is a red printed stamp and a postal cancellation from 'GENEVE' (Geneva). The handwritten address is in Russian and Latin script, addressed to someone in Russia.
